'''''Dark Nest I: The Joiner King''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Troy Denning]]. It is the first volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy]]'', and it was first published on [[July 26]], [[2005]] by [[Del Rey]]. An [[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King (abridged audiobook)|audiobook]] version was also produced.

The novel is set in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and it introduces the titular [[Dark Nest Crisis]].
